Subject: Action needed: renewal forecast + churn flags (Acme Corp)

Team / Sarah —

Following up on our quarter-end forecasting cadence. Finance needs a confirmed renewal commit for Acme (RDW-ACM-2026) by EOD Friday so we can lock Q4 ARR and finalize the FinOps runbook. Two specific asks: 

1) Internal ask (Redwood): Naomi / Ben — please confirm stage (Contract Sent / Committed / At Risk) in the HubSpot deal and add a short rationale for any At Risk flags. We need explicit owners and a mitigation ETA for any churn flags.

2) Customer ask (Acme): Sarah — can you confirm the PO status and whether your procurement team expects any delays beyond Oct 22? If there are any legal redlines pending, let us know so we can coordinate the timely sign-off.

I attached an updated Mutual Action Plan (MAP) with the timeline we discussed. If we don't have explicit commit status by Friday 17:00 PT, finance will model this as 60% probability for Q4 and it will affect the consolidated forecast.

Quick notes: include any upsell SKUs in the forecast if the PO includes them; otherwise they should be modeled separately. If you mark Account as At Risk please add a one-sentence reason (pricing / procurement / technical) + proposed next-step owner.

Thanks —
David
David Kim
Director, Revenue Finance
Redwood Inference

Attachment: MutualActionPlan_Acme_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)
